title: chore(ci): exercise the Node 22 engines floor in CI and mechanically guard the hand-mirrored engines range
body:
## Background

The engines claim `"node": "^22.22.2 || >=24.2.0"` is advertised,
locally pinned, and never tested:

- `.nvmrc`, `.node-version`, and `.tool-versions` all pin
  `22.22.2` — the developer/adopter recommendation.
- Every workflow that pins Node pins `24.x`
  (`pnpm-boundary.yml`, `scheduled-typecheck.yml`,
  `post-merge-cleanup.yml`); the unpinned lanes run the runner
  default and only assert the floor.
- `@types/node` is `26.1.0`, so typecheck validates against Node 26
  APIs.

A helper that adopts an API present in types-26 but absent/broken on
Node 22.22.x passes typecheck (types are 26), passes CI (runs 24+),
and then crashes for every developer and adopter on the repo's own
recommended pin. This bug class already bit once (#1447:
`import.meta.main` silently falsy on 24.0/24.1), and
`verify-workshop-integrity.mts` already uses still-maturing
`fs.globSync` options. The 22.x half of the engines claim is
enforced nowhere mechanically.

Separately, the engines range is hand-mirrored in ~8 places with no
guard — including two copy-pasted inline semver checkers in
`lint.yml` and `idd-advisory-convergence.yml` whose comments boast
"Exact match to package.json's engines.node", plus prose mirrors in
CONTRIBUTING (3 languages), `docs/typescript-sources.md`,
`docs/workshop/README.md`, and `docs/stalled-session-quiet-check.md`.
The next engines bump that misses one inlined check either keeps
admitting a dropped Node line or hard-fails newly-supported ones.
Mechanical guards for mirrored surfaces are this repository's own
convention; this surface is the unguarded outlier.

## Proposed change

1. Add one CI execution on `node-version: 22.22.2` —
   `pnpm-boundary.yml` already accepts `node-version` as a
   `workflow_call` input, so a tiny matrix or a second invocation
   suffices. Run at least the test suite there.
2. Make the two workflow floor-assert steps read
   `package.json`'s `engines.node` and evaluate it (both lanes run
   after checkout), or add a consistency test asserting the workflow
   snippets and doc mentions contain the current engines string.
3. Decide within the PR whether to align `@types/node` with the
   lowest supported line (or document why types-26 is acceptable
   with the 22-lane as the runtime backstop).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CI runs the test suite on Node 22.22.x on every PR (or a
      documented equivalent cadence with rationale).
- [ ] A deliberate local mismatch between `engines.node` and a
      workflow checker/doc mention fails a test or the workflow
      itself (demonstrated in the PR).
- [ ] The `@types/node`-vs-engines tension is resolved or explicitly
      documented.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes on both lanes.

Refs: 2026-07-28 fresh-model audit (build agent); #1447 (the prior
version-skew incident this guards against).

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented._
